title: Normalize Process Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize process/plugin/rs/lib.rs (Process3dPlayApp) to the wave-4 Consistency Contract: adopt SDK PanelKit (tree_item_with_action/tree_item_desc/PanelTreeBuilder) for build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree, adopt SDK Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled Process3dLabels struct+consts+resolver and the hand-rolled action/utility label-map functions, adopt SDK Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) replacing local meta()/new_app() test scaffolding, unwrap the incorrectly-nested `pub mod app_3d { ... }` to a flat single-app crate layout (C4), rename the "🔖Bundle" region into a single "🔖Manifest" region (C2) and add a "🧪Tests" region marker (C3), and reorder regions into canonical order where practical. C1 app-struct naming (Process3dPlayApp) is already compliant; verify only.
